entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... I was hoping I could get some help with a return, please.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number?
Yes, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF778190.

Thank you, Alex. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. It looks like that was delivered about 27 days ago. To get this started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue?
Oh, well... it's just, the color isn't what I expected from the photos online. It clashes with all my gear. I know it's a small thing, but I was so excited and now I'm just... disappointed.
I understand. Is it a technical fault with the helmet, or more of a preference regarding the color?

It's just the color. The helmet itself is fine, I assume. The box is still unopened. I haven't even touched it. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and honestly, I really needed this money back for another bill. I just feel awful about the whole thing.

I completely understand, and I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. We want to make sure you're happy, especially with something as important as your safety equipment. Let me just review the return eligibility for this item.
Okay, I have good news. The helmet falls under our standard 90-day return policy. Since you're within that timeframe, I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Are you sure? Thank you so much.

Of course. I've just initiated that return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. You can just print that out, attach it to the original package, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see the refund in 3-5 business days.
Wow. Okay. Thank you, Sarah. You've really made my day.
You're very welcome, Alex. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
